prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. She stands alone inside a modern brushed-metal elevator and holds a small bouquet of yellow flowers at chest level. Dress her in a soft beige wool coat with natural texture over a pale-yellow button-up shirt and small gold hoop earrings. Her hair is slightly damp, naturally textured, and loosely parted; use minimal editorial makeup with visible skin texture, soft blush, and natural lips. Frame a centered mid-torso, eye-level, straight-on portrait with a neutral introspective gaze toward camera, reflective walls, subtle symmetry, and softly blurred background. Use soft cool overhead fluorescent light, gentle facial falloff, low-to-medium contrast, muted greens and steel contrasted with warm yellow flowers, 50mm f/1.8 shallow depth, subtle grain, cinematic color grading, and no HDR.
